title: The Growth Kinetic and Ultra High Hardness of CoCrFeNiTi High–Entropy Alloy by Mechanical Alloying and Spark Plasma Sintering

recollection.starting_material: Guess: Co, Cr, Fe, Ni, Ti metal powders
recollection.intervention: Guess: Mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering
recollection.structure: Guess: High-entropy alloy with a potentially homogeneous structure
recollection.mechanism: Guess: Mechanical alloying leads to mixing and refinement of powders, while spark plasma sintering enables rapid densification
recollection.results: Guess: Ultra-high hardness due to the formation of a high-entropy alloy with potentially unique grain boundaries and solid-solution strengthening

score.note: The intervention merely repeats the title’s mechanical alloying/SPS methods without milling or sintering conditions. The structure is vague and omits the nanocrystalline 83% FCC/17% BCC phase mixture. The proposed powder refinement, rapid densification, grain-boundary effects, and solid-solution strengthening are directionally correct beyond the title. No quantitative hardness, strength, phase fraction, grain-size, or processing values are recalled.
